caption: From priority to accepted work. Engineering models inform the assignment and its acceptance conditions. An agent produces changes, but independent evidence determines whether they can be accepted. Interrupted or rejected work returns to repair or recovery without discarding durable results.
conversion: Shared geometry emits monochrome SVG and native TikZ
svg_description: An illustrative workflow progresses from priority to design, work order, agent implementation, acceptance gate, and integrated work. Engineering models supply scope and context to the work order and obligations to the gate. Independent acceptance evidence feeds the gate separately. Rejected work returns for repair; unresolved judgment goes to a human. An interrupted agent preserves durable commits and partial artifacts for recovery to inspect before resuming.
